中文description优先 + 新增建筑设计/建筑规范/建筑设计规范等中文搜索词

- Initial release of "code-to-skill" (v1.0.0): Convert building codes, regulations, and Chinese national standards (GB) into structured, queryable skills.
- Extracts every clause as an indexed file, preserving original mandatory/optional legal language (应/宜/可/不应/不得) and mapping cross-references.
- Data tables are parsed into structured JSON for reliable lookup.
- Multiple operation modes: Full conversion, analyze-only preview, or supplement/update existing skills.
- Requires "book-to-skill" skill for PDF extraction engine.
- Suitable for use cases like regulation knowledge base building, precise clause lookup, or code compliance workflows for GB 50xxx series.
